title: The top bubbbles.....
text: The top bubbbles...... After the first time using this "handy table,"  the surface got a big bubble underneath the black top.  I don't recall using anything wet or really hot on the surface and I was surprised the top bubbled so quickly!  By then I had thrown out the box it came in and it was awkward to return by postage anyway, so I kept the two tables BUT the surface did bubble which means.....its cheaply made!  Would not buy again although it serves its purpose.
